description: Track how much of the old DEEP and STATE supply has been redeemed for 2DEEP since the DGP-3 upgrade on 2026-09-22, and how much is still outstanding. Returns the redemption ratio, when the upgrade executed (block and time), DEEP and STATE redeemed totals and counts, 2DEEP minted for STATE redemptions, and what remains redeemable of each, plus a daily series over an optional from/to window. These totals and counts come from an indexed event stream and are a floor, not an exact count: `truncated` is true when the window held more events than one read caps at, and the index is still being backfilled for 2026-09-22/23 while a replay runs, so until that finishes, treat counts as at-least, not exact. Redemption has no deadline; this reports progress so far. Call 1s_ds_token_2deep for the current live totals instead of a point-in-time snapshot.

from.description: Inclusive lower bound, RFC 3339 or unix seconds. Default: the DGP-3 upgrade itself

to.description: Exclusive upper bound, RFC 3339 or unix seconds. Default: now

name: 1s_ds_migration
title: Deepstate DGP-3 Migration
